implementation.name: original-quantization
implementation.scope: The existing symmetric INT8 two-term dot product, with INT32 accumulation and ReLU after requantization. The source diagram and numerical exports are unchanged.
implementation.question: Which values are stored, and which are still moving?

purpose: Keep the committed sum visible while an incoming product moves; reveal the next result only when the action completes.
guard: The readout must not report the target sum as stored before the moving product arrives. Dashed destinations mean pending work, not completed computation. Motion is illustrative, not hardware timing.
